finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: Player input being used to set board cells without validation
finding.assumptions: The code assumes that the board cells are not used in any command execution. If the board data is later used in a command execution without proper validation, this could lead to OS command injection.

parsed.refutation_attempt: I searched the entire fragment for any use of system(), exec(), popen(), or other OS command execution primitives. None were present. The lines cited in the finding (68, 76, 85, 95) only involve I/O, validation, and assignment to a string array (board[choice - 1] or board[choice] = player.symbol). No constructed command string is passed to a shell or executed. Therefore the claim of OS command injection is unfounded.
